title: 生態滯留雨水花園
summary: 以「從街道逕流到雨水花園的滯留與處理」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow detention and treatment from street runoff to rain gardens through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.
